newsitem.title: GERMANY: German unemployment rises to 4.04 mln in Oct.
newsitem.headline: German unemployment rises to 4.04 mln in Oct.

text.p: German unemployment rose to a seasonally adjusted 4.04 million in October, surpassing four million for the first time, the Federal Labour Office said on Thursday.
The unadjusted unemployment rate was steady at September's level of 10.1 percent, with the number of unemployed workers rising 41,000 from September.

In western Germany, the seasonally adjusted figure rose to 2.886 million in October from 2.856 million the month before. Eastern Germany added 11,000 to unemployment rolls, lifting its total to 1.154 million.
